rows.text: THE TAP RECORD — the level study: one row per tap of an EXPORTED line (SPX KING / XG2–XG5, SPY KING / SG2–SG5 on ES; QQQ KING / G2–G5 on NQ) plus two controls (the rest of the 0DTE book ≥ 20%, and the midpoint between adjacent lines), stamped with book · rank · signed % · the conditions at the tap (tap number, FRESH / TESTED / DELIVERED / DECAYING, growth into the tap and day-over-day, King distance, gatekeepers, the pocket behind, the other book’s line within 5 pts, his key levels, approach speed and flush, regime, trinity, the clock, before / after the first extreme) and scored in trading terms (broke / mfe / mae / reach / R; DEFLECT · PIN · BREAK at 10 and 20 bars; was it the extreme; did the move resume) — nightly, on Analysis, by book × rank and by each condition with n, always beside the control.
rows.changes: a recorder module (the tap detector + the outcome filler, pure, on fixture bars), an IndexedDB store `taps` mirrored into the day file, a nightly reader, one table on Analysis; the 110 registry studies whose corpus is “tap record” start reading from it; H11 (fresh + growing deflects more than tested or shedding, both more than the midpoint) registered the day the record starts; nothing on the face until the report’s mockup
